{"ServerStorage.MountainWorld.MeasuredFinish":"-- Baked visual finish for the measured terrain sculpt; no gameplay mutation.
local M={}
function M.apply(world)
 assert(game.PlaceId==0 and not game:GetService('RunService'):IsRunning(),'Local Edit only')
 assert(world:GetAttribute('MeasuredSculptRevision')==42,'Requires measured sculpt 42')
 assert(not world:FindFirstChild('ArenaRockFaces'),'Already applied')
 local palette={Rock={115,123,119},Slate={110,119,115},Limestone={128,137,122},Sandstone={132,137,118},Sand={143,140,112},Basalt={91,101,98},Grass={104,139,90}}
 for name,rgb in pairs(palette) do workspace.Terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material[name],Color3.fromRGB(unpack(rgb))) end
 local root=Instance.new('Folder');root.Name='ArenaRockFaces'
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new();overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include;overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={world}
 local catalog=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MountainShared.Catalog)
 local template=assert(game.ServerStorage.MountainArtAssets:FindFirstChild('WaterfallCliff'))
 for i,k in ipairs(catalog.kingdoms) do
  local arena=world[k.name].ArenaFloor
  local out=Vector3.new(arena.Position.X,0,arena.Position.Z).Unit
  local side=Vector3.new(-out.Z,0,out.X)
  local heights={48,55,44,33,38,30}
  local widths={64,60,62,43,45,40}
  local tints={{190,166,125},{182,193,174},{228,192,126},{204,180,207},{151,137,123},{237,238,225}}
  for j=0,0 do
   local p=template:Clone();p.Name='RootedArenaCliff_'..i..'_'..j
   p.Size=Vector3.new(widths[i],heights[i],48)
   local pos=arena.Position+out*37-Vector3.new(0,p.Size.Y/2+12,0)
   p.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+out)*CFrame.Angles(0,(i%3-1)*.09,0)
   for _,near in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(p.CFrame,p.Size+Vector3.new(2,2,2),overlap)) do
    assert(not near.CanCollide and not near:FindFirstChildOfClass('ProximityPrompt'),'Cliff overlaps gameplay: '..near:GetFullName())
   end
   p.Color=Color3.new(1,1,1)
   local surface=p:FindFirstChildOfClass('SurfaceAppearance');if surface then surface.Color=Color3.fromRGB(unpack(tints[i])) end
   p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.Parent=root
  end
  task.wait()
 end
 root:SetAttribute('Revision',2)
 root.Parent=world
 return {faces=#root:GetChildren(),densityChanges=0,colliderChanges=0}
end
return M
","ReplicatedStorage.MountainShared.Tycoon":"local C=if script then require(script.Parent.Catalog) else require('./Catalog')
local Config=if script then require(script.Parent.TycoonConfig) else require('./TycoonConfig')
local T={config=Config}
local function integer(v,lo,hi) return type(v)=='number' and v==v and v%1==0 and v>=lo and v<=hi end
local function fraction(v) return type(v)=='number' and v==v and v>=0 and v<1 end
local function find(p,id) for _,c in ipairs(p.creatures) do if c.id==id then return c end end end
local function storeValid(s) return type(s)=='table' and integer(s.eggs,0,Config.maxCount) and integer(s.value,0,Config.maxCount*100) and ((s.eggs==0 and s.value==0) or (s.eggs>0 and s.value>=s.eggs)) end
function T.valid(t)
 if type(t)~='table' or t.version~=1 or not integer(t.slots,2,8) or not integer(t.lastAt,0,9007199254740991) or not storeValid(t.bag) or not fraction(t.bankCarry) or not table.find(Config.cosmetics,t.cosmetic) then return false end
 if type(t.levels)~='table' or type(t.habitats)~='table' or #t.habitats~=8 then return false end
 for k,v in pairs(t.habitats) do if not integer(k,1,8) then return false end end
 for _,key in ipairs({'production','storage','bag','banking','automation'}) do if not integer(t.levels[key],0,#Config.paths[key].costs) then return false end end
 local seen={}
 for i,h in ipairs(t.habitats) do
  if not storeValid(h) or not integer(h.level,0,4) or not integer(h.kingdom,1,6) or not fraction(h.progress) or not fraction(h.processCarry) or not integer(h.cycle,0,9) then return false end
  if h.creature~=nil then
   if type(h.creature)~='string' or #h.creature<1 or #h.creature>80 or seen[h.creature] or i>t.slots then return false end
   seen[h.creature]=true
  end
 end
 return true
end
function T.ensure(p,now)
 if p.tycoon then return p.tycoon end
 local habitats={}
 for i=1,8 do habitats[i]={level=0,kingdom=1,eggs=0,value=0,progress=0,processCarry=0,cycle=0} end
 p.tycoon={version=1,slots=2,lastAt=math.floor(now),habitats=habitats,bag={eggs=0,value=0},levels={production=0,storage=0,bag=0,banking=0,automation=0},bankCarry=0,cosmetic='Nature'}
 return p.tycoon
end
function T.capacity(p,index) return 30+30*p.tycoon.levels.storage+10*p.tycoon.habitats[index].level end
function T.bagCapacity(p) return 20+20*p.tycoon.levels.bag end
function T.rate(p,index)
 local t=p.tycoon;local h=t.habitats[index];local c=h.creature and find(p,h.creature)
 if not c then return 0,0,0 end
 local species=C.byId[c.species];if not species then return 0,0,0 end
 local kin=0
 for i,other in ipairs(t.habitats) do
  local adjacent=(math.floor((i-1)/2)==math.floor((index-1)/2) and i~=index) or math.abs(i-index)==2
  local v=adjacent and i<=t.slots and other.creature and find(p,other.creature)
  if v and C.byId[v.species].kingdom==species.kingdom then kin+=1 end
 end
 local bonus=(if species.kingdom==h.kingdom then .05 else 0)+math.min(kin,2)*.05
 local rarity=Config.rarity[species.rarity]
 return rarity.rate*(1+t.levels.production*.15+h.level*.1)*(1+bonus),rarity.value,bonus
end
function T.collect(p,index)
 local t=p.tycoon
 if not integer(index,0,t.slots) then return 0 end
 local order={};for i=1,t.slots do if index==0 or index==i then table.insert(order,i) end end
 if t.levels.automation>=3 then table.sort(order,function(a,b)
  local x,y=t.habitats[a],t.habitats[b]
  local xv,yv=x.value/math.max(1,x.eggs),y.value/math.max(1,y.eggs)
  return if xv==yv then a<b else xv>yv
 end) end
 local moved=0
 for _,i in ipairs(order) do
  local h=t.habitats[i];local n=math.min(h.eggs,math.max(0,T.bagCapacity(p)-t.bag.eggs))
  if n>0 then
   local value=if n==h.eggs then h.value else math.floor(h.value*n/h.eggs)
   h.eggs-=n;h.value-=value;t.bag.eggs+=n;t.bag.value+=value;moved+=n
  end
 end
 return moved
end
function T.bank(p)
 local t=p.tycoon;if t.bag.eggs==0 then return 0 end
 local raw=t.bag.value*(1+t.levels.banking*.025)+t.bankCarry
 local value=math.floor(raw+1e-8)
 if p.coins+value>9007199254740991 then return 0 end
 t.bankCarry=math.max(0,raw-value);p.coins+=value;t.bag.eggs=0;t.bag.value=0
 return value
end
function T.settle(p,now,offline)
 local t=T.ensure(p,now)
 if not integer(now,0,9007199254740991) or now<=t.lastAt then return 0 end
 local elapsed=math.min(now-t.lastAt,Config.offlineSeconds);t.lastAt=now
 local made=0
 for i=1,t.slots do
  local h=t.habitats[i];local rate,value=T.rate(p,i)
  local raw=h.progress+elapsed*rate/3600;local whole=math.floor(raw+1e-8)
  h.progress=math.max(0,raw-whole)
  local count=math.min(whole,math.max(0,T.capacity(p,i)-h.eggs))
  local bonus=math.floor((h.cycle+count)/10);h.cycle=(h.cycle+count)%10
  local amount=(count+bonus)*value
  if t.levels.automation>=2 then
   local extra=amount*.05+h.processCarry;local added=math.floor(extra+1e-8)
   h.processCarry=math.max(0,extra-added);amount+=added
  end
  h.eggs+=count;h.value+=amount;made+=count
 end
 -- Offline catchup never drains storage, including when automatic banking is unlocked.
 if not offline and t.levels.automation>=4 then
  if t.levels.automation>=5 then
   T.bank(p)
   -- At most eight bounded stores; empty with finite batches, no per-egg iteration.
   for _=1,80 do if T.collect(p,0)==0 then break end;T.bank(p) end
  else T.collect(p,0) end
 end
 return made
end
function T.assign(p,index,id,now)
 local t=p.tycoon
 if not integer(index,1,t.slots) or (id~=nil and (type(id)~='string' or not find(p,id))) then return false end
 for i,h in ipairs(t.habitats) do if id and h.creature==id and i~=index then return false end end
 T.settle(p,now,false)
 t.habitats[index].creature=id;t.habitats[index].progress=0
 return true
end
function T.attune(p,index,kingdom,now)
 if not integer(index,1,p.tycoon.slots) or not integer(kingdom,1,6) or kingdom>p.unlocked then return false end
 T.settle(p,now,false);p.tycoon.habitats[index].kingdom=kingdom;return true
end
function T.swap(p,first,second,now)
 local t=p.tycoon
 if not integer(first,1,t.slots) or not integer(second,1,t.slots) or first==second then return false end
 local a,b=t.habitats[first],t.habitats[second]
 if not b.creature or not find(p,b.creature) or (a.creature and not find(p,a.creature)) then return false end
 T.settle(p,now,false)
 a.creature,b.creature=b.creature,a.creature
 -- Fractional production follows its creature; stored eggs remain in each habitat.
 a.progress,b.progress=b.progress,a.progress
 return true
end
function T.upgradeEffect(p,path)
 local t=p.tycoon
 if path=='habitats' then return 'Active habitats: '..t.slots..' → '..math.min(8,t.slots+1)
 elseif path=='habitat' then return '+10% base egg rate · +10 egg storage'
 elseif path=='production' then return '+15% base egg rate in every habitat'
 elseif path=='storage' then return 'Each habitat: +30 egg storage'
 elseif path=='bag' then return 'Bag: '..T.bagCapacity(p)..' → '..(T.bagCapacity(p)+20)..' eggs'
 elseif path=='banking' then return string.format('Bank value bonus: %.1f%% → %.1f%%',t.levels.banking*2.5,(t.levels.banking+1)*2.5)
 elseif path=='automation' then return Config.automation[t.levels.automation+1] or 'All automation installed' end
 return ''
end
function T.quote(p,path,index)
 local def=Config.paths[path];if not def then return nil end
 local t=p.tycoon;local level
 if path=='habitat' then if not integer(index,1,t.slots) then return nil end;level=t.habitats[index].level
 elseif path=='habitats' then level=t.slots-2 else level=t.levels[path] end
 local cost=def.costs[level+1];if not cost then return nil end
 local ready=true
 if path=='automation' and level>=1 then ready=t.levels.production>=math.min(level,4) and t.levels.storage>=math.min(level,4) and t.levels.banking>=math.max(0,level-2) end
 return {cost=cost,level=level,next=level+1,ready=ready,requirement=if ready then '' else 'Requires production/storage '..math.min(level,4)..' and banking '..math.max(0,level-2)}
end
function T.upgrade(p,path,index,now)
 local q=T.quote(p,path,index);if not q or not q.ready or p.coins<q.cost then return false end
 T.settle(p,now,false);p.coins-=q.cost
 if path=='habitats' then p.tycoon.slots+=1 elseif path=='habitat' then p.tycoon.habitats[index].level+=1 else p.tycoon.levels[path]+=1 end
 return true
end
function T.cosmetic(p,id)
 if not table.find(Config.cosmetics,id) then return false end
 p.tycoon.cosmetic=id;return true
end
function T.snapshot(p)
 local t=p.tycoon;local rows={};local eggs,value,rate=0,0,0
 for i,h in ipairs(t.habitats) do
  local r,v,bonus=T.rate(p,i);eggs+=h.eggs;value+=h.value;rate+=r
  rows[i]={creature=h.creature,level=h.level,kingdom=h.kingdom,eggs=h.eggs,value=h.value,capacity=T.capacity(p,i),rate=r,bonus=bonus,unlocked=i<=t.slots}
 end
 return {slots=t.slots,habitats=rows,eggs=eggs,value=value,rate=rate,bag=table.clone(t.bag),bagCapacity=T.bagCapacity(p),levels=table.clone(t.levels),cosmetic=t.cosmetic,offlineSeconds=Config.offlineSeconds}
end
return T
","ServerScriptService.MountainServer.Sanctuary":"local Sessions=require(script.Parent.SanctuarySessions)
local S={}
function S.new(model)
 assert(model and model:IsA('Model'),'Use the baked sanctuary integration review')
 local allocator=Sessions.new(8)
 local plots={}
 for i=1,8 do
  local plot=assert(model.SanctuaryPlots:FindFirstChild(string.format('Plot_%02d',i)))
  local spawn=assert(plot:FindFirstChild('Spawn'))
  spawn.Enabled=false -- Main owns all character spawns, never random shared pads.
  plots[i]={model=plot,spawn=spawn,floor=assert(plot:FindFirstChild('Plot_180x220'))}
 end
 local gates={}
 for _,gate in ipairs(model.ThreeGates_NoGameplay:GetChildren()) do
  local cf=gate:GetBoundingBox()
  local marker=Instance.new('Part');marker.Name='EnterBlossom';marker.Size=Vector3.new(5,5,1)
  marker.CFrame=CFrame.new(cf.X,19,cf.Z+6);marker.Anchored=true;marker.CanCollide=false;marker.CanTouch=false;marker.Transparency=1
  local prompt=Instance.new('ProximityPrompt');prompt.ActionText='Enter Blossom';prompt.ObjectText='Impossible Mountain';prompt.HoldDuration=.35;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=12;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.Parent=marker
  marker.Parent=gate;gates[marker]=true
 end
 local service={}
 function service.model(index) return plots[index] and plots[index].model end
 local function slot(player) return allocator.plot(player.UserId,player) end
 function service.plot(player) return slot(player) end
 function service.spawn(player)
  local i=slot(player);return i and plots[i].spawn.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,4,0)
 end
 function service.ownsPosition(player,pos)
  local i=slot(player);if not i then return false end
  local floor=plots[i].floor;local q=floor.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
  return math.abs(q.X)<=floor.Size.X/2-1 and math.abs(q.Z)<=floor.Size.Z/2-1 and q.Y>=0 and q.Y<=45
 end
 function service.inSanctuary(pos)
  local center=plots[4].floor.Position.X+94
  local mountain=workspace:FindFirstChild('ImpossibleMountain')
  local north=if mountain and mountain:GetAttribute('FreeClimbVersion') then -157 else -1400
  return math.abs(pos.X-center)<1250 and pos.Z>north and pos.Z<550
 end
 function service.nearGate(pos)
  for marker in pairs(gates) do if (marker.Position-pos).Magnitude<=15 then return true end end
  return false
 end
 function service.prompt(part,player,pos)
  if gates[part] and (part.Position-pos).Magnitude<=15 then return 'Gate' end
  local i=slot(player)
  if i and part:GetAttribute('SanctuarySlot')==i and part:IsDescendantOf(plots[i].model) and (part.Position-pos).Magnitude<=15 then return part:GetAttribute('Service') end
 end
 function service.reserve(player)
  local i=allocator.reserve(player.UserId,player);if not i then return nil end
  plots[i].model:SetAttribute('OwnerUserId',player.UserId)
  player:SetAttribute('SanctuaryPlot',i)
  return i
 end
 function service.release(player)
  local i=slot(player)
  if i then plots[i].model:SetAttribute('OwnerUserId',nil) end
  allocator.release(player.UserId,player)
 end
 for i,plot in ipairs(plots) do
  for j,kind in ipairs({'Incubator','Training'}) do
   local marker=Instance.new('Part');marker.Name=kind..'Service';marker.Size=Vector3.new(3,2,3)
   marker.CFrame=plot.spawn.CFrame+Vector3.new(if j==1 then -8 else 8,1,-10)
   marker.Anchored=true;marker.CanCollide=false;marker.CanTouch=false;marker.Material=Enum.Material.Wood
   marker.Color=if j==1 then Color3.fromRGB(133,187,177) else Color3.fromRGB(204,168,105)
   marker:SetAttribute('SanctuarySlot',i);marker:SetAttribute('Service',kind)
   local prompt=Instance.new('ProximityPrompt');prompt.ActionText=if j==1 then 'Incubate / hatch' else 'Train companions'
   prompt.ObjectText='Your sanctuary';prompt.MaxActivationDistance=12;prompt.HoldDuration=.2;prompt.Parent=marker
   marker.Parent=plot.model
  end
 end
 return service
end
return S
","ServerScriptService.MountainServer.Store":"-- Store (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): persistence adapter. Profile code only sees this interface:
--   store:read(key)        -> ok, value|nil, err
--   store:update(key, fn)  -> ok, value|nil, err   fn(old) returns the new value, or nil to cancel the write
--                            (UpdateAsync semantics: fn may run more than once; keep it free of side effects
--                            other than setting locals the caller resets before each call).
-- Two implementations:
--   Store.datastore(name)  real DataStoreService (UNVERIFIED: the place is unpublished, PlaceId = 0)
--   Store.memory(opts)     in-memory mock for Studio + tests. Values round-trip through JSON like a DataStore,
--                          so non-serializable data fails here too. Failure injection: failNext (n calls),
--                          failAll (bool), latency (s), conflicts (n: run fn twice to mimic a retried write).
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Store = {}

---------------------------------------------------------------- memory mock
local Memory = {}
Memory.__index = Memory

function Store.memory(opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	return setmetatable({
		kind = "memory",
		backend = opts.backend or {}, -- share one backend between two "servers" in tests
		failNext = 0,
		failAll = false,
		latency = opts.latency or 0,
		conflicts = 0,
		failAfterCommit = 0, -- response lost AFTER durable write; exercises uncertain outcome replay
		calls = { read = 0, update = 0, failed = 0 },
	}, Memory)
end

function Memory:_gate(kind)
	self.calls[kind] += 1
	if self.latency > 0 then
		task.wait(self.latency)
	end
	if self.failAll then
		self.calls.failed += 1
		return false, "mock: store unavailable (failAll)"
	end
	if self.failNext > 0 then
		self.failNext -= 1
		self.calls.failed += 1
		return false, "mock: store request failed (failNext)"
	end
	return true
end

function Memory:read(key)
	local ok, err = self:_gate("read")
	if not ok then
		return false, nil, err
	end
	local raw = self.backend[key]
	return true, raw and HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) or nil, nil
end

function Memory:update(key, fn)
	local ok, err = self:_gate("update")
	if not ok then
		return false, nil, err
	end
	local runs = 1 + math.max(0, self.conflicts)
	self.conflicts = 0
	local new
	for _ = 1, runs do
		local raw = self.backend[key]
		local old = raw and HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) or nil
		local okFn, res = pcall(fn, old)
		if not okFn then
			return false, nil, "transform error: " .. tostring(res)
		end
		new = res
	end
	if new == nil then
		local raw = self.backend[key]
		return true, raw and HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) or nil, "cancelled"
	end
	local okEnc, enc = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, new)
	if not okEnc then
		return false, nil, "serialize: " .. tostring(enc)
	end
	self.backend[key] = enc
	if self.failAfterCommit > 0 then
		self.failAfterCommit -= 1
		return false, nil, "mock: response lost after commit"
	end
	return true, HttpService:JSONDecode(enc), nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- real DataStore (UNVERIFIED in Studio)
local DS = {}
DS.__index = DS

function Store.datastore(name)
	local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
	local ok, ds = pcall(DataStoreService.GetDataStore, DataStoreService, name)
	return setmetatable({ kind = "datastore", ds = ok and ds or nil, initErr = (not ok) and tostring(ds) or nil, service = DataStoreService }, DS)
end

function DS:_budget(reqType)
	-- wait (bounded) for request budget instead of letting the request throttle
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		local okB, b = pcall(self.service.GetRequestBudgetForRequestType, self.service, reqType)
		if not okB or b > 0 then
			return
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end

function DS:read(key)
	if not self.ds then
		return false, nil, self.initErr
	end
	self:_budget(Enum.DataStoreRequestType.GetAsync)
	local ok, res = pcall(self.ds.GetAsync, self.ds, key)
	if not ok then
		return false, nil, tostring(res)
	end
	return true, res, nil
end

function DS:update(key, fn)
	if not self.ds then
		return false, nil, self.initErr
	end
	self:_budget(Enum.DataStoreRequestType.UpdateAsync)
	local cancelled = false
	local ok, res = pcall(self.ds.UpdateAsync, self.ds, key, function(old)
		local new = fn(old)
		cancelled = new == nil
		return new
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, nil, tostring(res)
	end
	return true, res, cancelled and "cancelled" or nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- choice
-- Real DataStore only in a published place; Studio with PlaceId 0 cannot reach DataStores at all.
function Store.default(name)
	if game.PlaceId ~= 0 then
		return Store.datastore(name)
	end
	return Store.memory()
end

return Store
","ServerStorage.MountainWorld.World":"local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MountainShared.Catalog)
local TerrainProfile=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MountainShared.TerrainProfile)
local A=require(script.Parent.Art)
local Landmarks=require(script.Parent.Landmarks)
local W={}
local function v(p) return Vector3.new(p.x,p.y,p.z) end
local function folder(parent,name) local f=Instance.new('Folder');f.Name=name;f.Parent=parent;return f end
local function attrs(p,t) for k,x in pairs(t) do p:SetAttribute(k,x) end end
local function prompt(p,action,kind,k,id)
 attrs(p,{Kind=kind,Kingdom=k,Id=id or p.Name})
 local q=Instance.new('ProximityPrompt');q.ActionText=action;q.ObjectText=p.Name;q.HoldDuration=.4;q.MaxActivationDistance=12;q.RequiresLineOfSight=false;q.Parent=p;return p
end
local function deck(parent,name,pos,size,color,material)
 return A.part(parent,name,size,CFrame.new(pos-Vector3.new(0,size.Y/2,0)),color,material,nil,true)
end
local function walkway(parent,name,a,b,width,k)
 local delta=b-a;local len=delta.Magnitude
 workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.lookAt((a+b)/2+Vector3.new(0,10,0),b+Vector3.new(0,10,0)),Vector3.new(width+6,20,len+4),Enum.Material.Air)
 return A.part(parent,name,Vector3.new(width,1.2,len+1),CFrame.lookAt((a+b)/2,b),A.color(k.color):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(211,201,173),.5),Enum.Material.Cobblestone,nil,true)
end
local function arch(parent,pos,k,radius,frame)
 frame=frame or CFrame.new(pos)
 local col=A.color(k.rock):Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.3)
 for i=0,10 do local a=math.pi*i/10
  A.part(parent,'ArchVoussoir',Vector3.new(4,5,6),frame*CFrame.new(math.cos(a)*radius,7+math.sin(a)*radius,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,a-math.pi/2),col,Enum.Material.Marble,nil,true)
 end
 for _,s in ipairs({-1,1}) do A.part(parent,'Pillar',Vector3.new(4,9,6),frame*CFrame.new(s*radius,4.5,0),col,Enum.Material.Marble,nil,true) end

  if now<session.nextAt then return finish(result(id,action,false,'Please wait before trying another action.')) end

  session.nextAt=now+interval

  session.running=id

","ReplicatedStorage.MountainShared.RunRules":"-- Pure custody. secure() mutates only a caller-owned transaction draft.
local C=if script then require(script.Parent.Catalog) else require('./Catalog')
local Run={}
local function text(v) return type(v)=='string' and #v>0 and #v<=128 end
local function eggs(list)
 if type(list)~='table' then return false end
 local count=0
 for key,e in pairs(list) do
  if type(key)~='number' or key%1~=0 or key<1 or key>#list or type(e)~='table' or not text(e.id) or not C.byId[e.species] or C.byId[e.species].rarity=='Legendary' then return false end
  count+=1
 end
 return count==#list
end
function Run.migrate(p)
 if type(p)~='table' or (p.schema~=1 and p.schema~=2) then return nil end
 if p.schema==2 then return p end
 if not eggs(p.eggs) or not eggs(p.cargo) or (p.recovery~=nil and (type(p.recovery)~='table' or not eggs(p.recovery.eggs))) then return nil end
 local identities={}
 for _,list in ipairs({p.eggs,p.cargo,if p.recovery then p.recovery.eggs else {}}) do for _,e in ipairs(list) do
  local previous=identities[e.id]
  if previous and (previous.species~=e.species or (previous.readyAt~=nil and e.readyAt~=nil and previous.readyAt~=e.readyAt)) then return nil end
  identities[e.id]=previous or e
 end end
 local seen={};for _,e in ipairs(p.eggs) do if seen[e.id] then return nil end;seen[e.id]=true end
 local entitlements={}
 for _,list in ipairs({p.cargo,if p.recovery then p.recovery.eggs else {}}) do
  for _,e in ipairs(list) do
   if type(e)~='table' or not text(e.id) or not C.byId[e.species] or C.byId[e.species].rarity=='Legendary' then return nil end
   if not seen[e.id] then seen[e.id]=true;table.insert(entitlements,table.clone(e)) end
  end
 end
 p.legacyEntitlements={};for _,e in ipairs(entitlements) do table.insert(p.eggs,e);p.legacyEntitlements[e.id]=true end
 p.cargo={};p.recovery=nil;p.run=nil;p.securedRunIds={};p.schema=2
 return p
end
function Run.strike(p,egg,now)
 if p.schema~=2 or type(egg)~='table' or not text(egg.id) or not text(egg.runId) or not C.byId[egg.species] or type(egg.section)~='number' or egg.section%1~=0 or egg.section<1 or egg.section>6 or type(now)~='number' or now~=now then return false,'invalid' end
 if egg.trial and (not p.wins[tostring(egg.section)] or p.captures[egg.species]) then return false,'trial_unavailable' end
 if p.run and (p.run.eggId~=egg.id or p.run.id~=egg.runId or p.run.phase~='breaking') then return false,'full_hands' end
 if not p.run then p.run={id=egg.runId,eggId=egg.id,species=egg.species,section=egg.section,trial=egg.trial==true,phase='breaking',hits=0,startedAt=now} end
 p.run.hits+=1
 if p.run.hits>=math.max(1,egg.hitsRequired or 1) then p.run.phase='revealed' end
 return true
end
function Run.pickup(p,runId)
 local r=p.run;if not r or r.id~=runId or r.phase~='revealed' then return false,'no_reveal' end
 r.phase='carried';return true
end
function Run.forfeit(p,reason)
 if not p.run then return false end
 p.run=nil;return true,reason
end
function Run.secure(p,runId)
 for _,id in ipairs(p.securedRunIds or {}) do if id==runId then return true,'already_secured' end end
 local r=p.run
 if not r or r.id~=runId or r.phase~='carried' then return false,'not_carried' end
 if r.trial and p.captures[r.species] then return false,'already_captured' end
 p.serial+=1
 table.insert(p.creatures,{id='c'..p.serial,species=r.species,level=1,xp=0})
 if r.trial then p.captures[r.species]=true end
 p.securedRunIds=p.securedRunIds or {};table.insert(p.securedRunIds,runId)
 if #p.securedRunIds>128 then table.remove(p.securedRunIds,1) end
 p.run=nil;return true,'secured'
end
return Run

 return math.max(0,math.ceil(deadline-now))
end
function P.formatTime(seconds)
 local n = if finite(seconds) then math.max(0,math.ceil(seconds)) else 0
 if n>=3600 then return string.format('%d:%02d:%02d',math.floor(n/3600),math.floor(n/60)%60,n%60) end
 return string.format('%d:%02d',math.floor(n/60),n%60)
end
function P.creature(c)
 local species = c and C.byId[c.species]
 if not species then
  return {name='Unknown creature',rarity='Unknown',element='Unknown',role='Unknown',stage=1,attack=0,health=0,xpRequired=0,abilityNames={}}
 end
 local level = if finite(c.level) then math.clamp(math.floor(c.level),1,50) else 1
 local stats = R.stats({species=c.species,level=level,specialization=c.specialization})
 return {name=species.name,rarity=species.rarity,element=species.element,role=species.role,
  stage=R.stage(level),attack=stats.attack,health=stats.health,xpRequired=if level>=50 then 0 else level*40,
  abilityNames=if species.abilities then table.clone(species.abilities) else {roleSkills[species.role] or 'Special'}}
end
function P.filterCreatures(profile,query,rarity,sort)
 local found = {}
 local search = string.lower(tostring(query or '')):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or ''
 local tier = string.lower(tostring(rarity or 'all'))
 local teamOrder = {}
 for slot,id in ipairs(if profile then profile.team or {} else {}) do teamOrder[id]=slot end
 for _,c in ipairs(if profile then profile.creatures or {} else {}) do
  local s = C.byId[c.species]
  if s then
   local searchable = string.lower(table.concat({s.name,s.rarity,s.element,s.role,c.id or ''},' '))
   if (tier=='' or tier=='all' or string.lower(s.rarity)==tier) and (search=='' or string.find(searchable,search,1,true)) then
    table.insert(found,c)
   end
  end
 end
 local mode=string.lower(tostring(sort or 'name'))
 table.sort(found,function(a,b)
  local sa,sb=C.byId[a.species],C.byId[b.species]
  if mode=='team' and (teamOrder[a.id] or 4)~=(teamOrder[b.id] or 4) then return (teamOrder[a.id] or 4)<(teamOrder[b.id] or 4) end
  if mode=='level' and a.level~=b.level then return a.level>b.level end
  if mode=='rarity' and rarityOrder[sa.rarity]~=rarityOrder[sb.rarity] then return rarityOrder[sa.rarity]>rarityOrder[sb.rarity] end
  if sa.name~=sb.name then return sa.name<sb.name end
  return tostring(a.id)<tostring(b.id)
 end)
 return found
end
function P.quest(profile)
 if not profile then return {title='Preparing your mountain',detail='Waiting for the server profile.',progress=0,total=1} end
 if profile.schema==2 then
  if profile.run then return {title=if profile.run.phase=='carried' then 'Escape to sanctuary' elseif profile.run.phase=='revealed' then 'Pick up your creature' else 'Break the guarded egg',detail='Follow the clear downhill lane. Only the sanctuary exit secures this attempt.',progress=0,total=1} end
  local count=0;for k=1,6 do if profile.discoveries[k..':entrance'] then count+=1 end end
  return {title='Explore any of the six sections',detail='Find a visible egg, tap each strike, then carry your creature to sanctuary.',progress=count,total=6}
 end
 local discoveries,wins=profile.discoveries or {},profile.wins or {}
 for k,kingdom in ipairs(C.kingdoms) do
  if not wins[tostring(k)] then
   if not discoveries[tostring(k)..':entrance'] then
    return {title='Explore '..kingdom.name,detail='Reach the entrance checkpoint on the mountain route.',progress=0,total=1}
   end
   return {title='Challenge '..C.guardians[k].name,detail='Find the Guardian altar in '..kingdom.name..'.',progress=k-1,total=#C.kingdoms}
  end
 end
 return {title=if discoveries.summit then 'Summit discovered' else 'Reach the Impossible Summit',
  detail=if discoveries.summit then 'Explore branches and return for Legendary Trials.' else 'Follow the Astral Crown route to the summit.',
  progress=if discoveries.summit then 1 else 0,total=1}
end
